Abstract

A flow in which the Client asks for authentication directly.

Table of Contents

  • 1. Introduction
  • 7.1. Authentication Request

1. Introduction

The Client starts the flow without the user's browser.

7. Backchannel Authentication Endpoint

The endpoint is used to start the flow.

7.1. Authentication Request

The Client MUST send an authentication request by HTTP POST.

  1. The Client makes the request.
  2. The OP responds with an identifier.

7.1.1. Signed Authentication Request

A signed request SHOULD be a signed JWT.
